raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- With decode context parallelism (DCP) on ROCm, MLA target verify runs on the AITER asm cp round-robin (cprr) kernel (`AiterAttnBackend._forward_verify_asm_cprr`, already on main).
- That kernel takes the query only as unit-scale fp8 (`q.view(n_rows, -1).to(fp8_dtype)`, `q_scale = 1`) and reads the verify window from the KV cache, so it never uses `k_window`.
- The model still does bf16 work on every verify step, every layer:
  - all-gathers `q_nope_out` and `q_pe` in bf16 across the DCP group;
  - runs `torch.cat` to build the full `[rows, H * dcp, nope + rope]` query;
  - runs `torch.cat` on `k_nope`/`k_pe` to build a `k_window` the cprr route ignores.
- The cast is elementwise and the all-gather is a byte copy, so casting local heads to fp8 before the gather gives the same bytes, moves half the data, and skips the full-width cat.

## Modifications

- `layers/dcp/comm.py`: new `all_gather_q_fp8_for_mla_verify`.
  - Each rank writes `q_nope_out`/`q_pe` into one fp8 `[H, B, nope + rope]` symmetric-memory buffer, gathers along heads, and returns a contiguous fp8 `[B, H * dcp, nope + rope]`.
  - The custom all-gather moves only 16/32-bit floats, so the buffer goes on the wire as bf16 (uint8 for an odd row width).
- `AttentionBackend.takes_fp8_dcp_verify_q()` (default `False`): whether DCP MLA target verify wants that fp8 query and no window K/V.
  - `AiterAttnBackend` returns `forward_metadata.use_asm_cprr_verify`.
  - `HybridLinearAttnBackend`, `HybridAttnBackend` and `TboAttnBackend` forward it to the backend that runs target verify.
- `forward_mla_rocm.py`: the DCP verify query and window follow the table below.

| Condition (DCP decode phase, target verify) | Query gather | `k_window` / `v_window` |
|---|---|---|
| `_use_aiter`, backend `takes_fp8_dcp_verify_q()`, no `llama_4_scaling` | fp8 gather, passed straight to `attn_mqa_for_dcp_decode` | skipped |
| Backend `takes_fp8_dcp_verify_q()`, `llama_4_scaling` set | bf16 gather + cat (backend casts) | skipped |
| Any other case (non-cprr verify, DSA triton) | `all_gather_q_for_mla_decode` as before | built as before |

## Accuracy Tests

- The kernel gets the same fp8 query bytes as before, and the cprr route never read `k_window`, so outputs should not change.
- Unit test `test/registered/unit/layers/test_dcp_fp8_q_gather.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`):
  - 8 thread "ranks" share a byte-copy all-gather set as the DCP group via `get_parallel().override`.
  - For e4m3fn and e4m3fnuz, at 5 and 260 tokens, the fp8 gather is byte-identical to bf16 gather + cat + cast, including values past the e4m3 range and below its subnormals.
  - Swapping the head order of the rope half makes all 4 subtests fail.

End to end: 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, TP8, DCP8, DSpark block 4 with real acceptance (target verify on the asm cprr route).

| Setup | Value |
|---|---|
| Build | Kimi-K3 integration build (`k3-agentx-c56` plus the open K3 PRs) |
| AITER | `6ae4bf0f2` (`yuychang/aiter` `k3-agentx-c56`), ROCm 7.2.4 |
| A/B | Integration build vs the same build with only this change reverted, one server each |
| Eval | sgl-eval 0.1.3 GSM8K, 1319 questions, `--load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3` (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on), 1 run each |

| | Reverted | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | 97.42% | 97.04% |
| Mean accept length | 3.60 | 3.65 |

- One-run GSM8K standard error here is about 0.45 points, so the 0.38-point gap is within noise.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Per verify step, rank 0, one run. Measured with this change before its rebase onto current `main`, Kimi-K3 integration build, 8x MI355X, TP8, DCP8, DSpark block 4 (AgentX concurrency-56 setup):

| | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| DCP query all-gather | 1.863 ms | 1.140 ms |
| Query `torch.cat` | 1.048 ms | 0.004 ms |

End to end, same setup and A/B as the accuracy test. `bench_serving` random dataset, 8K input / 1K output, one run per concurrency:

| Concurrency | TPOT reverted | TPOT this PR | Change |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16 | 13.44 ms | 13.66 ms | +1.6% |
| 32 | 22.02 ms | 22.08 ms | +0.3% |
| 60 | 25.62 ms | 25.48 ms | -0.5% |

- The per-step saving does not show up in end-to-end TPOT here; the differences go both ways and are within one-run noise.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+def all_gather_q_fp8_for_mla_verify(
+    *, q_nope_out: torch.Tensor, q_pe: torch.Tensor, fp8_dtype: torch.dtype
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Gather [B, H, nope] and [B, H, rope] into a unit-scale fp8 [B, H * dcp, nope + rope]."""
+    group = get_parallel().dcp_group
+    d_nope = q_nope_out.size(-1)
+    num_tokens, num_heads, d_pe = q_pe.shape
+    with use_symmetric_memory(group):
+        local = q_pe.new_empty((num_heads, num_tokens, d_nope + d_pe), dtype=fp8_dtype)
+    # The cast is elementwise and the gather copies bytes,
+    # so this matches casting the gathered bf16 query bit for bit.
+    local[..., :d_nope].copy_(q_nope_out.transpose(0, 1))
+    local[..., d_nope:].copy_(q_pe.transpose(0, 1))
+    # The custom all-gather moves only 16- and 32-bit floats; pair bytes when the row allows.
+    wire = torch.bfloat16 if local.shape[-1] % 2 == 0 else torch.uint8
+    gathered = group.all_gather(local.view(wire), dim=0)
+    return gathered.view(fp8_dtype).transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+

+_WORLD = 8
+_HEADS = 12
+_NOPE = 512
+_ROPE = 64
+
+
+class _ThreadGroup:
+    """Byte-copy all_gather along dim 0 across one thread per rank."""
+
+    def __init__(self, world_size: int):
+        self.world_size = world_size
+        self._barrier = threading.Barrier(world_size)
+        self._parts = [None] * world_size
+        self._local = threading.local()
+
+    def bind(self, rank: int) -> None:
+        self._local.rank = rank
+
+    def all_gather(self, input_: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert dim == 0
+        self._parts[self._local.rank] = input_.clone()
+        self._barrier.wait()
+        out = torch.cat(self._parts, dim=0)
+        self._barrier.wait()
+        return out
+
+
+def _rank_queries(*, rank: int, num_tokens: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(rank)
+    # The absorb BMM writes [H, B, nope]; the rope half is a slice of q_b_proj.
+    q_nope_out = torch.randn(_HEADS, num_tokens, _NOPE, generator=gen) * 64
+    q = torch.randn(num_tokens, _HEADS, 128 + _ROPE, generator=gen) * 64
+    # Past the e4m3 range and below its subnormals.
+    q_nope_out[0, 0, :4] = torch.tensor([1e4, -1e4, 1e-9, -1e-9])
+    return (
+        q_nope_out.to(torch.bfloat16).transpose(0, 1),
+        q.to(torch.bfloat16)[..., 128:],
+    )
+
+
+def _run_ranks(fn, *, num_tokens: int):
+    group = _ThreadGroup(_WORLD)
+
+    def run(rank: int):
+        group.bind(rank)
+        q_nope_out, q_pe = _rank_queries(rank=rank, num_tokens=num_tokens)
+        return fn(q_nope_out=q_nope_out, q_pe=q_pe)
+
+    with get_parallel().override(dcp_group=group):
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=_WORLD) as pool:
+            return list(pool.map(run, range(_WORLD)))
+
+
+class TestDcpFp8QueryGather(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_matches_cast_after_bf16_gather(self):
+        # The cprr verify kernel casts its query at unit scale;
+        # the gather copies bytes, so casting first must give the same bytes per rank.
+        for fp8_dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz):
+            for num_tokens in (5, 260):
+                with self.subTest(dtype=fp8_dtype, num_tokens=num_tokens):
+
+                    def bf16_then_cast(*, q_nope_out, q_pe):
+                        q_nope_out, q_pe = comm.all_gather_q_for_mla_decode(
+                            q_nope_out=q_nope_out, q_pe=q_pe
+                        )
+                        q = torch.cat([q_nope_out, q_pe], dim=-1)
+                        rows = q.shape[0]
+                        return q.view(rows, -1).to(fp8_dtype).view(q.shape)
+
+                    def fp8_gather(*, q_nope_out, q_pe):
+                        return comm.all_gather_q_fp8_for_mla_verify(
+                            q_nope_out=q_nope_out, q_pe=q_pe, fp8_dtype=fp8_dtype
+                        )
+
+                    want = _run_ranks(bf16_then_cast, num_tokens=num_tokens)
+                    got = _run_ranks(fp8_gather, num_tokens=num_tokens)
+                    for rank in range(_WORLD):
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            got[rank].shape,
+                            (num_tokens, _HEADS * _WORLD, _NOPE + _ROPE),
+                        )
+                        self.assertTrue(got[rank].is_contiguous())
+                        self.assertTrue(
+                            torch.equal(
+                                got[rank].view(torch.uint8),
+                                want[rank].view(torch.uint8),
+                            )
+                        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
